text: I feel a surge of curiosity and possibility. The modern, bright environment and the prominent display declaring R+D suggests a dedication to innovation and collective striving for knowledge. Being here, I am reminded of the continuous human quest to understand, to create, and to connect. I’m intrigued by the intersection of art, technology, and science—spaces like this invite reflection on the progress and direction of human thought. I feel both energized and thoughtful, aware of my place within a lineage of inquisitive minds.
